metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1993 · Farewell My Concubine
metas.description: Two boys meet at an opera training school in Peking in 1924. Their resulting friendship will span nearly 70 years and endure some of the most troublesome times in China's history.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1998 · The Legend of 1900
metas.description: A baby boy discovered on an ocean liner in 1900 grows into a musical prodigy, never setting foot on land.
